name: manual_308667
claim: Worker primitive contract: workers are one generic primitive. TaskEnvelope(role, specialization, intent, prompt, depth=0) in, WorkerResult(status, summary, artifacts, errors) out. depth ALWAYS 0 in V1 (no sub-workers) — enforced by field_validator at runtime, not convention. Write artifacts to disk before returning status=done.
